info.name: Sanad App — Elderly
info.description: Elderly self-service app routes. Requests require an Elderly Normal JWT. The take-dose request writes shared medication history and is a manual fixture example; use only an approved disposable fixture and do not replay it after a successful take.

request.description: Normal Elderly JWT. The dependent is resolved solely from the authenticated identity and must belong to an active Family. Returns bilingual names, age computed in the stored IANA timezone, hasPhoto/photoUrl, latest linked assessment, timeZoneId, and nullable primary emergencyContact. Address and healthNotes are intentionally omitted. Read-only.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('arabicFullName'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('englishFullName'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('age'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('hasPhoto'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('photoUrl'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('timeZoneId'); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('emergencyContact'); if (body.emergencyContact) { pm.expect(body.emergencyContact).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(body.emergencyContact).to.have.property('relationship'); pm.expect(body.emergencyContact).to.have.property('phoneNumber'); } pm.expect(body).not.have.property('detailedAddress'); pm.expect(body).not.have.property('healthNotes'); }

request.description: Normal Elderly JWT; returns private image bytes for the linked profile. No public file URL. 404 when no photo is stored. Read-only.

exec: pm.test('photo is returned or absent', function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Normal Elderly JWT. The dependent is resolved from the authenticated Elderly identity; no dependent ID is accepted. Read-only.

item.name: Get medication dashboard for profile-local date

request.description: Read-only. date is required as YYYY-MM-DD and uses the linked Elderly profile's local calendar semantics; it has no server-date default.
Contract check; with a valid Elderly JWT this should return 400 because date is required.

item.name: Record scheduled dose as taken — manual fixture only

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: records a shared dose log, attributes the action to the Elderly user, and decrements tracked stock. Only use an approved disposable fixture where this medication is Active, the date is in range, and scheduledTime is configured. A second or racing take must be rejected. Do not replay against shared or production data.

Normal Elderly JWT only. Resolves the currently linked dependent and evaluates only the current profile-local day against the active versioned CMS threshold (initially 60 minutes). Response includes thresholdMinutes, settingVersion, localDate, and missedDoses. This request may persist current-day dose logs and idempotent durable in-app alerts; use only an approved disposable fixture. Push/email/outbox/scheduler delivery is deferred/Needs Owner Verification; SMS is excluded.

exec: pm.test('late evaluation contract outcome', function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Normal Elderly JWT. Published-only, shared CMS content. pageSize defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Tenant scope is not defined.
Normal Elderly JWT. Returns only published content; missing/unpublished IDs return 404 Cms.WellnessTip.NotPublished.

item.name: 05. Help requests
item.description: ElderlyAccess routes are identity-bound to the authenticated Elderly user. GET requests are safe and limited to one-year availability. POST create/cancel requests are manual fixture-only mutations; do not replay them against shared or production data.

request.description: Read-only. Returns the authenticated Elderly user's newest-first requests from the last year. Deleted/inactive Family links and foreign IDs are not disclosed.
Read-only. Returns the caller-owned request or 404 Families.HelpRequest.NotFound. The server does not accept an Elderly ID.

STATE-CHANGING: active catalog keys are required for actor/action/need; qualifier and plain-text customText are optional, customText max 500 chars. Same idempotency key plus same normalized payload replays the original request; a different payload returns 409 Families.HelpRequest.IdempotencyConflict. Creates durable in-app alerts for active linked Family recipients with helpRequestAlerts enabled, the assigned caregiver only while an active Confirmed/InProgress booking exists and the caregiver account is active with helpRequestAlerts enabled, and active SupportAdmin accounts. A missing/mismatched identity-bound Elderly profile or any required Identity recipient-query failure yields no recipients (fail closed). Alert creation is idempotent per request/recipient. Use an approved disposable fixture; push/email/provider/outbox/retry are deferred and SMS is excluded.
STATE-CHANGING: Pending requests may be cancelled by their Elderly owner. Reason is optional and capped at 500 characters. Use an approved disposable fixture only.

item.name: Submit daily check-in — manual fixture only

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: Normal Elderly JWT only. The server resolves the profile from the authenticated identity and records one final Boolean answer per profile-local IANA calendar day. Same-answer retry returns the saved record; an opposite answer returns 409 Families.ElderlyCheckIn.AlreadyAnswered. A false answer creates durable in-app alerts for active linked Family members with checkInAlerts enabled. Use only an approved disposable fixture; do not replay against shared or production data. Families and Notifications persistence are separate and not an atomic transaction. No SMS; push/provider retry, reminders, and missed-check-in behavior are deferred.

item.name: 05. SOS (manual mutation and safe reads)
item.description: Elderly Normal JWT only. The server binds SOS to the authenticated Elderly identity. Create/cancel are state-changing and manual-fixture-only; reads are safe contract requests. No SMS or server-side dialer is claimed.

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: use only with an approved disposable Elderly/Family fixture. Coordinates must be paired, consent-gated, and are stored rounded to three decimals. Replaying the same key and payload is idempotent; a different payload conflicts with 409 Families.Sos.IdempotencyConflict.

exec: pm.test('SOS create contract outcome', function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: SAFE READ: identity-bound to the Elderly JWT; newest first. Coordinates are returned only within 30 days of creation.

exec: pm.test('SOS list contract outcome', function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: SAFE READ: foreign, unknown, or deleted-Family events return 404 Families.Sos.NotFound; terminal states remain terminal.

exec: pm.test('SOS detail contract outcome', function () { pm.expect([200, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: STATE-CHANGING: manual fixture only. Cancels Open or Acknowledged; Resolved and Cancelled are terminal.

exec: pm.test('SOS cancel contract outcome', function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401, 403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
